name: Unity LevelPlay
what_it_is: An ad mediation platform from Unity Technologies, documented with SDKs and a platform dashboard.
platforms: Unity, Android, iOS, Adobe AIR, Flutter and React Native SDKs

facts.fact: Unity LevelPlay is an ad mediation platform that helps publishers drive higher revenue, acquire new players and get total monetization control.
LevelPlay integration is available directly from the Unity Editor and an SDK, per the product page.
The Unity documentation lists LevelPlay SDKs for Unity, Android, iOS, Adobe AIR, Flutter and React Native, plus a LevelPlay Platform for mediation settings.
The product page does not state LevelPlay pricing; it has a generic Pricing navigation link and a Get started button.
